---
title: "Examples and tutorials"
---

SCGSim owns the solver handoff, result, and report APIs. OrPen SC PDK owns the
public component-simulation notebooks. This site links a short package-owned
Xmon tutorial path without copying those notebooks.

## Learn the shared Xmon workflow

Start with the shared public Xmon inputs, then follow the Palace Route B path.
The AEDT page is a separate backend candidate. Its input contract retains an
authored `D0_TO_D1_GAP` as a vacuum entity while adding only the outer
background. Static pages do not establish native-geometry validation or a
solver run.

1. [Build the public Xmon inputs](tutorial-xmon-input.qmd): construct the
   component-local geometry, register named occurrences, set the Notebook's
   final `Net -> Entity` map, and prepare the immutable input snapshot.
2. [Prepare a Palace Route B Eigenmode handoff](tutorial-xmon-palace.qmd): use
   that snapshot with Palace-specific configuration and result resolution.
3. [Prepare an AEDT Route B Eigenmode handoff](tutorial-xmon-aedt.qmd): add
   catalogue-bound MA/MS/SA surfaces, the source-linked Xmon junction, and
   selected bulk domains using AEDT's backend-specific request.

The backend pages keep their setup, handoff, and result contracts separate.
Palace and AEDT Route B pages show backend-specific handoff preparation; the
pages include pre-solve input summaries and the verified returned-package
resolution steps, but do not perform a native geometry check or solver run.
Both remain converging candidates. For Route A background and the complete
public notebook context, use the pinned
[OrPen Xmon component-simulation sources](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/orpen-sc-pdk/tree/35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/Kosen2024_Xmon).
The [geometry guide](geometry-sgb.qmd) explains SCGSim's Route A/B geometry
choices.

## Prerequisites and scope

Use Python 3.12 or 3.13 with the public OrPen SC PDK inputs at revision
[`35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9`](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/orpen-sc-pdk/tree/35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9).
That revision declares OrPen SC PDK `0.1.0` and GDSFactory 9.48.x; the
[pinned project metadata](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/orpen-sc-pdk/blob/35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9/pyproject.toml)
records its dependency constraints. Read each backend page for its own local
runtime prerequisites. The Palace page documents a handoff; the AEDT page
documents its backend-specific candidate contract.

These pages target the SCGSim source checkpoint
[`a0e179ab014702a9889b1eb93b9192b3f54a8608`](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/scgsim/tree/a0e179ab014702a9889b1eb93b9192b3f54a8608).
The published `1.0.0.dev28` version string alone does not identify or
guarantee these source APIs; use the matching SCGSim checkout together with
the OrPen revision above. Quarto leaves code execution disabled. The pages
document handoff and result workflows; they do not report native solver runs
or numerical validation.

## Find a workflow by task

| If you want to… | Start here |
|---|---|
| Build the public Xmon geometry inputs | [Shared Xmon inputs](tutorial-xmon-input.qmd) |
| Inspect normalized inputs before mesh or handoff preparation | [Palace tutorial](tutorial-xmon-palace.qmd) or [AEDT tutorial](tutorial-xmon-aedt.qmd) |
| Prepare a Palace Route B Eigenmode handoff | [Palace tutorial](tutorial-xmon-palace.qmd) |
| Prepare an AEDT Route B surface, bulk, and junction EPR handoff | [AEDT tutorial](tutorial-xmon-aedt.qmd) |
| Resolve and show a complete returned run package | [Palace tutorial](tutorial-xmon-palace.qmd) or [AEDT tutorial](tutorial-xmon-aedt.qmd) |
| Load an existing result, inspect EPR, or update loss assumptions | [Eigenmode methods and offline EPR](eigenmode-epr.qmd) |
| Compare package capabilities and exercised evidence | [Backend support matrix](backend-support.qmd) |
| Place controls beside the notebook stage that uses them | [Notebook UX contracts](notebook-ux.qmd) |
| Prepare a local or Slurm handoff | [Execution profiles and handoff](execution-profiles.qmd) |
